title: सिंचाई पाइपलाइन - Irrigation Pipeline Scheme

benefits_as_displayed.small_and_marginal_farmers: 60% of unit cost or maximum INR 18000, whichever is lower
benefits_as_displayed.other_farmers: 50% of unit cost or maximum INR 15000, whichever is lower

eligibility_summary: Agricultural land must be owned in the farmer's name
Farmer must have an electricity, diesel or tractor-operated pump set on the well
Joint ownership and separate pipeline applications are subject to the conditions displayed on the portal
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card
Land ownership record (Jamabandi) not older than six months
application_process: Apply through Raj Kisan Sathi portal or an e-Mitra centre
Purchase pipeline only after Agriculture Department approval
Purchase from a registered manufacturer or authorised dealer
Department verifies the pipeline after purchase
Subsidy is deposited directly into the farmer's bank account
limitations: Portal snapshot does not include a separate government order or notification number
Subsidy amounts and eligibility must be rechecked against current official guidelines before providing final advice
Current financial year validity must be verified at query time
Joint ownership conditions must not be generalized beyond the displayed wording
notes: Official Raj Kisan Sathi portal snapshot dated 31 October 2026. Preserve Hindi conditions and subsidy limits accurately. Do not infer eligibility beyond the displayed text.
